sections.title: Introduction to Chick Lit
sections.description: This course will introduce students to the genre known as "Chick Lit," a label that emerged in the 1990s to encompass pleasurable fiction written primarily for women, by women, and about women. Although Chick Lit has been criticized for elevating the so-called “superficial,” “trivial,” and “fluffy” elements of women’s lives, it has nonetheless remained an enormously popular and influential segment of contemporary fiction. This course journeys through Chick Lit's predecessors, greatest hits, and new boundary-pushing work, in both novels and film. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
